description: TEMPORARY. Identical to vellum-default except it forces memory.v3.live=true after hatch. Fresh workspaces are supposed to boot v3-live via workspace migration 105, but the first-launch config seed persists live=false ~200ms before migrations run, and 105 defers to any existing value — so every hatched assistant silently runs memory v2. That blocks the v3-gated machinery the procedural-memory test measures (retrospective skill authoring). Use this profile instead of vellum-default when a test depends on memory v3. DELETE once vellum-assistant#39847 ships in the published images this harness hatches; vellum-default is correct again at that point.
